summary: Observation of the movement, stopping and a new start of a bright phenomenon in the sky; rapid disappearance: lack of information.
description: Recent testimony (December 2014) of an earlier sighting in August 1947 (the witness does not remember the day; the date of August 1st is arbitrary). The witness was leading his cows to pasture when he saw, very high in the sky, a bright object moving from east to west at very high speed, stopping abruptly for 30 seconds before moving off again very quickly and disappearing. This testimony was reported to GEIPAN in December 2014, more than 67 years after the event. The witness's memory seems very precise, but experience shows that one must be wary of memory fading over time. The reported observation resembles a Transient Light-Emitting Storm Phenomenon (PLOT), that is, a phenomenon similar to ball lightning, possible during stormy weather (the observation occurred in August, a month often stormy), even if the sky is clear: sudden stopping and high-speed departure are sometimes observed in this type of phenomenon. However, the witness describes a cylindrical or parallelepiped-shaped phenomenon, which is generally incompatible with these typically spherical phenomena. The age of the case and the lack of precise date prevent verification with the meteorological services. Therefore, this case is classified as "C" due to insufficient information (dates, weather).
